scenario: [LSER.16.9] / [LSER.18.1], read by a rule: `last all_time` is the newest sample absorbed for the identity. `all_time` routes `last` to the accumulator backing (SeriesBackendWelfordEwma): libds's `sbwe_query` DS_SERIES_AGG_LAST arm (`typed_last`), Mercury's `aggregate(agg_last)` over the unwindowed row (newest first). The samples are not monotone (3, 9, 4), so `last` differs from `first`, `min` and `max`. At 4 s a `Probe` arrives and `read` logs the binding's `last` ([NSBK.6.3]), once per `Reading` fact, since a `ttl` schema keeps each assert as a fact of its own: three messages.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope ttl 1_h:
    k: String
    v: Int

schema Probe scope explicit:
    k: Int

series Reading.v (by: k):
    last all_time

rule read:
    Probe
    Reading s
->
    log info "{s.last}"
